panel.alt: After the settled arrival, Aren and Pell stand compactly on the same fixed work shelf: Aren on its front-left clear floor, Pell just inside the ordinary rear gate on the rear-left clear floor. From a new high viewpoint at the return stair, all four boot soles and the original shelf perimeter are visible around the single raised socket to their right. Aren passes Pell the one compact shade at waist-to-chest height. His gray bag already rests open and empty on the adjacent masonry ledge. Rusk remains on the last ordinary stair with the closed case containing the removed old shade and tools.
